title: Ngā Kaihanga o ngā Pou Teitei
intro: Kei mua koe i ngā ururua o tētahi tāone tawhito whakahīhī, kua hinga ngā pou teitei. E hamama ana te hau i roto i ngā tiriti takoto kau, e mau ana i te maharatanga o tētahi iwi kaha i whakahaere i ēnei whenua i mua. Ko wai rātou?
clues: He iwi kaha rawa mātou, he iwi pūkenga hoki, i mōhiotia mō ō mātou whare nunui me te ao matatau.
I noho mātou i te whenua onepū me ngā pukepuke toka, ā, i whakapono mātou kāore he tangata e taea te hinga i a mātou.
I tae mai tētahi karere ki a mātou i roto i ō mātou whanaunga, e karanga ana kia karakia mātou ki a Allah anake, engari i whakakahoretia e mātou, ā, i tawaitia ia e mātou.
I whakamanamana mātou, 'Ko wai te mea kaha ake i a mātou?' ā, i haere tonu mātou i roto i tō mātou whakapehapeha me te karakia whakapakoko.
I tukua mai e Allah he hau nui ki a mātou, e whitu ngā pō me ngā rā e waru, ā, i whakangaro i ngā mea katoa.
Ko mātou te iwi o 'Ad, ngā kaihanga o Iram, ā, ko tō mātou aituā i waiho hei whakatūpato mō te hunga katoa i muri mai.

trial.label: He aha te whiu i tukuna ki a rātou?

location.label: Ko wai te ingoa o tō rātou tāone rongonui?

outcome.label: He aha te mutunga iho?
options: I whakangaromia rātou, ā, ko ō rātou toenga he akoranga
I ripeneta rātou, ā, i whakaorangia
I toremi rātou ki te moana
I tanumia rātou i raro i te whenua horo
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia rātou, ā, ko ō rātou toenga he akoranga

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
